source: Directive (EU) 2022/2555 (NIS2), with our own summaries. National transposition laws add detail; check your country's law.
disclaimer: This repository is general information to help you understand and organize work on AI governance frameworks. It is not legal advice and does not guarantee compliance, certification or any regulatory outcome. Requirements are summarized in our own words; always check the official texts and get qualified advice for your situation.

requirements.title: Scope: essential and important entities
requirements.summary: Check whether you are an essential or important entity based on sector (Annexes I and II), size and national designation.

requirements.title: Governance and management accountability
requirements.summary: Management bodies approve cybersecurity risk-management measures, oversee them, can be held liable, and must follow training.

requirements.title: Risk-management measures
requirements.summary: Take appropriate and proportionate technical, operational and organizational measures, using an all-hazards approach.

requirements.title: Risk analysis and information system security policies
requirements.summary: Policies on risk analysis and information system security.

requirements.title: Incident handling
requirements.summary: Processes to prevent, detect and respond to incidents.

requirements.title: Business continuity and crisis management
requirements.summary: Backup management, disaster recovery and crisis management.

requirements.title: Supply chain security
requirements.summary: Security of relationships with direct suppliers and service providers.

requirements.title: Secure acquisition, development and maintenance
requirements.summary: Security in network and information systems acquisition, development and maintenance, including vulnerability handling and disclosure.

requirements.title: Effectiveness assessment
requirements.summary: Policies and procedures to assess the effectiveness of risk-management measures.

requirements.title: Cyber hygiene and training
requirements.summary: Basic cyber hygiene practices and cybersecurity training.

requirements.title: Cryptography
requirements.summary: Policies on cryptography and, where appropriate, encryption.

requirements.title: HR security, access control and asset management
requirements.summary: Human resources security, access control policies and asset management.

requirements.title: Multi-factor authentication and secure communications
requirements.summary: Use MFA or continuous authentication and secured voice, video, text and emergency communications where appropriate.

requirements.title: Incident reporting
requirements.summary: Report significant incidents to the CSIRT or authority: early warning within 24 hours, notification within 72 hours, final report within one month.

requirements.title: Informing service recipients
requirements.summary: Inform recipients of significant incidents likely to affect their services without undue delay, where appropriate.

requirements.title: Registration with the authority
requirements.summary: Provide required information to the competent authority (for some digital entities, to the registry in the main establishment country).

requirements.title: Supervision
requirements.summary: Cooperate with supervision: inspections, audits, information requests.
